content:
The v4.19.0-rc2 release of Lean is here!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language.

Of particular note: parallel elaboration of theorems within a file has now arrived!

Please read the release notes for details.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.19.0-rc2.

  • there is a v4.19.0-rc2 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

We have released v4.19.0-rc3, which differs from rc2 only in the bug fix PRs lean#7852 and lean#7882.

As these should not affect any behaviour besides resolving deadlocks and task cancellation problems, we have decided to use an abbreviated release process: Mathlib has been updated to this release, with a v4.19.0-rc3 tag, but the repositories upstream of Mathlib have not been updated (or tagged).
Is it possible to bump doc-gen to v4.19.0-rc3 please? It’s breaking doc generation for downstream projects.
